abilities.name: IDPT PowerShell execution marker
abilities.simulation_action: Delegate the reviewed PowerShell marker action to the pinned local IDPT scenario.

telemetry.description: IDPT emits a correlated benign PowerShell execution marker.

abilities.cleanup_action: IDPT verifies that no cleanup is required.

abilities.name: IDPT scoped synthetic file discovery
abilities.simulation_action: Delegate run-owned synthetic file discovery to the pinned local IDPT scenario.

telemetry.description: IDPT enumerates only its run-owned synthetic victim tree.

abilities.cleanup_action: IDPT removes its run-owned synthetic work tree.

abilities.name: IDPT synthetic local-data read
abilities.simulation_action: Delegate reads of IDPT-seeded synthetic documents to the pinned local scenario.

telemetry.description: IDPT reads content only from run-owned synthetic documents.

abilities.cleanup_action: IDPT removes its run-owned synthetic work tree.

abilities.name: IDPT synthetic local data staging
abilities.simulation_action: Delegate creation and cleanup of a run-owned synthetic archive to the pinned local IDPT scenario.

telemetry.description: IDPT creates an archive containing only seeded synthetic documents.

abilities.cleanup_action: IDPT deletes the run-owned archive and verifies cleanup.

abilities.name: IDPT loopback collection marker
abilities.simulation_action: Delegate a synthetic correlation-only POST to IDPT's engine-owned loopback sink.

telemetry.description: IDPT sends only a synthetic run marker to its 127.0.0.1 sink.

abilities.cleanup_action: IDPT closes its ephemeral loopback sink.
